title: Principal Application Engineer
full_text:
Application Modernization Platform (“AMP”) is a MongoDB offering that modernises our customer’s legacy relational applications to a modern architecture underpinned by MongoDB using a combination of software, processes, and engineers. In this offering, the people and software are inextricably linked and cannot be separated. The delivery happens in an accelerated timeframe wherein the team takes advantage of GenAI and algorithmic tooling to expedite the turnaround time for application delivery.  

AMP team generally works with enterprise-grade customers, in all verticals on a variety of exciting use cases. This role solves technically sophisticated problems, gains incredible cross-stack experience, works with top-notch people in the business, addresses multiple customer-facing opportunities. The role also becomes the forefront of groundbreaking R&D that enables further acceleration for enterprises working across a variety of technologies.

AMP exists to expedite time to value for customers who are looking forward to changing, modernising and updating their tech stack while keeping MongoDB the cornerstone of their system architecture.

Work as a software developer in an Agile environment delivering solutions for customers focused on migrating our customers’ legacy relational-based Java applications to a more modern cloud-based architecture running on MongoDB, leveraging the latest GenAI tools and approaches to accelerate this process. During each project, successful candidates will be required to innovate on potential new GenAI-based solutions for specific challenges in addition to applying existing playbooks and tooling for migration.

This role will be based remotely in France.

Position Expectations

  • Shape architecture and technology strategy across AMP modernization projects and workstreams, making complex technical decisions with limited supervision and connecting engineering choices to customer and business outcomes
  • Lead the assessment and modernization of legacy Java applications by uncovering dependencies, embedded business logic, integration points, and operational constraints; recommend fit-for-purpose modernization paths rather than defaulting to lift-and-shift
  • Design, implement, and review production-quality solutions using Java and Spring Boot, including APIs, integrations, monolith decomposition, relational-to-document data modeling, stored-procedure transformation, schema evolution, and MongoDB operational practices
  • Establish safe, incremental delivery practices through explicit acceptance criteria, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and rollback, dual-run, or other risk-control strategies; identify quality, security, performance, and reliability risks and guide teams to resolve them
  • Serve as a senior technical partner to customers, application owners, and account and project stakeholders by explaining complex topics clearly, aligning priorities, navigating disagreement, communicating trade-offs, and maintaining trust through high-risk change
  • Multiply the effectiveness of engineers by mentoring, raising engineering standards, creating reusable migration playbooks and documentation, applying GenAI advancements responsibly where valuable, and influencing project direction without relying on formal authority

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Typically 8+ years of progressive experience designing, building, and delivering Java applications, including significant experience leading complex application modernization initiatives
  • Expert understanding of Java fundamentals, object-oriented design, concurrency, error handling, performance considerations, and maintainable software architecture; able to review code and guide design decisions across teams
  • Deep production experience with Spring Boot and related patterns for building resilient services, APIs, integrations, and testable distributed applications
  • Demonstrated ability to assess legacy estates, decompose monoliths, uncover dependencies and embedded business logic, and define practical modernization strategies with clear trade-offs
  • Strong experience with relational databases and SQL, including stored procedures, data dependencies, data migration, schema evolution, and relational-to-document modeling for MongoDB or comparable document databases
  • Proven history of delivering high-cadence modern applications using Agile methodologies, test-first development, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based version control, observability, and reliability practices; demonstrated success mentoring engineers and influencing technical outcomes across teams

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience in building REST APIs with Spring Boot
  • Experience in performance and memory optimization of JAVA applications
  • Familiarity with tools like Postman, IntelliJ IDEA, and Maven/Gradle
  • Exposure to other languages or technologies like JavaScript, .Net
  • Understanding of ORM tools like Hibernate, Spring Data  or JPA (even through coursework or self-study)
  • Experience in nascent GenAI technologies and approaches, such as using OpenAI/Anthropic API not purely through chat interfaces
  • Experience with AI-powered development tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or similar code assistants
  • Good experience of using MongoDB

Successful candidates will engage with customer systems and may be exposed to highly confidential customer data, including but not limited to non-public information. For this reason, and due to the nature of the highly regulated industry in which our customers operate, successful candidates may be subject to enhanced background checks, security screenings, and possible constraints around the trading of securities. Successful candidates will understand these requirements and be willing to participate in enhanced screenings and constraints as required by MongoDB and its customers in connection with this role. 

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

  • Contribuer à l’élaboration et au déploiement d’outils et des techniques d'IA.

  • Des qualités de chef de projet : coordination, agilité et priorisation des sujets

Ce que nous offrons :

  • Une expérience professionnelle unique au sein d'une compagnie média renommée, où vous pourrez acquérir des compétences précieuses et développer votre réseau professionnel.
  • L'opportunité de travailler avec des clients de premier plan et de contribuer à la création de campagnes publicitaires de grande envergure.

Process de recrutement

  • Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier pré-entretien téléphonique de 5mn, puis un entretien de 30mn en visio-conférence par un membre de notre équipe recrutement. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise.

Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. About Expert Insights:
Expert Insights, which spans AlphaSense’s Expert Transcript Library and 1x1 Call Services offerings,  delivers a new and transformative form of market intelligence content. AlphaSense’s library of over 220,000 transcripts is the market’s largest, covering all sectors of the economy, with thousands more published each month. The Directed Content Team is an integral part of the Expert Insights group, generating thousands of calls each quarter on high-value and strategic content targets - ensuring that the AlphaSense Expert Transcript Library (ETL) delivers comprehensive coverage to our users. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot. 2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data. 3. This is a software-first infrastructure role that combines strong software engineering with Linux systems and hardware-aware infrastructure automation. You will work closely with teams across Infrastructure, Networking, Data Center Operations, and Platform Engineering to bring new capacity online and continuously improve how we operate our infrastructure at scale.

title: Enterprise Account Executive at Datacor, Inc.

title: System Administrator (Hybrid in Indianapolis, IN) at Resultant

Job Description To support our continued growth and help solve our clients’ most challenging technology problems, we are looking for a Systems Administrator to join our team in Indianapolis, Indiana. In this role, you will administer and improve client technology environments spanning on-premises infrastructure, Microsoft cloud services, endpoint platforms, identity systems, and business-critical applications. You will work alongside service desk, engineering, security, automation, project, and client leadership teams to deliver secure, reliable, and well-managed technology solutions. Serve as a trusted technical resource for clients by communicating clearly, understanding business impact, and delivering a consistently strong service experience. Administer and support Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Azure, virtualization platforms, storage, backup, and recovery technologies. Manage identity and access services, including user administration, group and role management, authentication policies, conditional access, and multifactor authentication. Support and improve endpoint management, patching, application deployment, system monitoring, and device security across client environments. Maintain core infrastructure services, including DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, certificates, file services, remote access, and other integrated systems. Monitor the health, availability, performance, and capacity of client systems and take proactive action to prevent or minimize service disruption. Investigate complex incidents, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions that reduce repeat issues. Evaluate and remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities in coordination with security and service delivery teams. Follow established incident, problem, change, and configuration management practices to protect client environments and ensure work is performed with appropriate planning and documentation. Identify opportunities to standardize, automate, and improve recurring administrative work using tools such as PowerShell and managed-services automation platforms. Maintain accurate client documentation, configurations, procedures, and knowledge articles. Provide clear and timely updates within service tickets, including troubleshooting performed, decisions made, client communications, resolution details, and next steps. Accurately record time and work activity to support client communication, service reporting, capacity planning, and operational accountability. Participate in an on-call rotation and provide after-hours support for critical incidents or planned changes when needed. Work collaboratively with technical and client-facing teams to deliver solutions aligned with each client’s operational and business needs. Qualifications We are looking for someone with: Must live in the Indianapolis, IN area and willing to work a hybrid schedule with 3 days/week onsite Four to six years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure support, or a comparable technical role. Experience supporting multiple technology environments, preferably within a managed-services, consulting, or similarly client-focused organization. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work through complex or unfamiliar technical issues. A demonstrated ability to take ownership of incidents and assignments through resolution. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues, risks, and recommendations to audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge. A client-focused mindset with a strong sense of urgency, accountability, and attention to detail. The ability to prioritize competing responsibilities and work effectively across operational support, escalations, and project-based assignments. Experience working within established ticketing, documentation, change-management, and time-entry processes. A willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and provide occasional after-hours support. A Microsoft role-based certification, or an equivalent technical certification, is preferred. The ability to live within commuting distance of Indianapolis and work a hybrid schedule that currently includes three days per week onsite. Legal authorization to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship. Technical Experience Qualified candidates should have experience in several of the following areas: Microsoft infrastructure: Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificate management, file services, and remote access. Cloud and identity: Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365 administration, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, multifactor authentication, and conditional access. Virtualization and compute: VMware, Hyper-V, Azure Virtual Desktop, Remote Desktop Services, or comparable platforms. Endpoint management: Microsoft Intune, configuration policies, software deployment, operating system patching, device lifecycle management, and endpoint troubleshooting. Security: Identity protection, endpoint security, vulnerability remediation, email security, least-privilege administration, and security-policy implementation. Backup and recovery: Backup monitoring, recovery validation, business continuity, and disaster-recovery technologies. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Search & Recommendations
full_text:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

 

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

 

What does the team work on?

Roku is the No. 1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico with 70+ million active accounts. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. The depth of query, content, and user understanding using ML is key to user happiness on the search and discovery journey, and this team owns the models that power it across the Roku platform.

What is the role?

The depth of query, content and user understanding using ML is key to user happiness in their search journey. Solving this customer problem is why we’re actively looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Search & Recommendations to drive further innovation in search and discovery. The person in this role will leverage their technical skills, business intuition, and analytical thinking to build best-of-class AI-powered products. Communication and presentation skills are important. The role requires both high technical acumen and problem-solving abilities, motivation, and exceptional attention to detail. Every day, you’ll look at what exists and find ways to make it better.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Apply state of the art ML on search using techniques in deep learning, bandits, transformers, LLMs, causal inference, and optimisations to make our users more delighted and engaged on the platform
  • Run online AB tests and analyse them against the critical business KPIs
  • Collaborate with US engineering teams as well as cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Nurture our ML ecosystem to make it withstand scale, developer velocity and future business shifts
  • Provide technical leadership to drive technical and ML roadmap for search ranking and monetisation
  • Help in recruiting new engineers. Interview, train, and mentor new team members

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

  • 8+ years of experience (or PhD with 6 years of experience) applying Machine Learning to concrete problems at large-scale in domains like recommendation or search or ads
  • Strong CS fundamentals. Should be able to convert ideas to code with ease
  • Good understanding of machine learning fundamentals like classification, deep neural nets, and sequence-based models. Familiarity with modern NLP stack and multi-modal representation learning is a plus
  • We’d love to see that you’ve worked with big data systems (Spark, S3, and Airflow) and can program (Java, Scala, or Python)
  • Good understanding of system architecture. Have experience in big data technologies and streaming architecture, data pipelines, etc.
  • Demonstrated AI/agentic-tooling fluency per the section above
  • MS in Computer Science, Statistics, or related field, but a Ph.D. in CS or related fields is preferred
#LI-MS3

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

 

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

 

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

title: Systems Security Engineer
full_text:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

We are seeking an Infrastructure Security Engineer to drive security engineering and operational security across both our Australian and corporate ICT environments. You will work alongside a small infrastructure team responsible for designing, hardening and operating networks accredited under the Australian Government’s Protective Security Policy Framework (PSPF) and the ASD Information Security Manual (ISM), as well as supporting security tooling on the corporate network.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with security platforms spanning endpoint protection, SIEM, vulnerability management, identity and access management, and privileged access management. They are comfortable operating in environments subject to Australian Government security frameworks and can translate ISM controls and Essential Eight maturity targets into practical engineering outcomes.

About the Job

What You’ll Do

  • This is not an ISSO or ISSM role. This is a technical, hands-on security engineering position.
  • Own and operate security tooling across Australian and corporate networks, including deployment, configuration, tuning, patching and lifecycle management.
  • Administer and mature the Australian network’s security stack, including application whitelisting, SIEM, vulnerability scanning, endpoint antivirus and privileged access management.
  • Support corporate network security platforms, including endpoint detection and response, identity and access management, privileged access management, and device trust and compliance.
  • Drive Essential Eight maturity uplift across Australian environments, with a focus on application control, patching, privileged access restriction, multi-factor authentication and regular backups.
  • Develop and maintain SIEM use cases, detection rules, correlation searches and dashboards to provide actionable visibility across the environment.
  • Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, analyse findings, prioritise remediation and track closure through the Plan of Action and Milestones (POAM) register.
  • Perform security hardening of Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualisation platforms, storage infrastructure and network devices in accordance with ASD hardening guidance and the ISM.
  • Contribute to security architecture assessments, threat modelling and risk assessments for new and existing systems.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure engineers to integrate security into system designs, change plans and standard operating procedures.
  • Support system accreditation activities, including preparation of security documentation (SSPs, SRMPs, IRPs, DLDs) and evidence gathering for assessments.
  • Brief security posture, risks and recommendations to management and government stakeholders.
  • Assist with security incident response, investigation and post-incident review.

Required Qualifications

  • Three or more years of experience in one or more of the following: cyber security engineering, security operations, systems security, infrastructure security or security architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with at least three of the following security platform types:
    • Application whitelisting or application control
    • SIEM and log management
    • Vulnerability scanning and assessment
    • Endpoint detection and response (EDR)
    • Privileged access management (PAM)
    • Identity and access management (IAM)
  • Strong understanding of Active Directory, Group Policy, Windows Server hardening and Kerberos authentication.
  • Familiarity with Australian Government security frameworks: the ISM, PSPF, Essential Eight Maturity Model and associated ASD guidance.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear security documentation and brief both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach to working in a small team where everyone shares the load.
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a NV2 security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • An existing NV2 security clearance.
  • Experience working in or supporting high-security environments accredited under Australian Government frameworks.
  • Experience with Windows Server and VMware vSphere administration and security hardening.
  • Experience with enterprise backup and recovery platforms and an understanding of data protection requirements under the ISM.
  • Familiarity with device trust and compliance tooling.
  • Experience developing SIEM dashboards, alerts, detection content and integrations.
  • Scripting skills in PowerShell, Python or Bash for automation of security operations tasks.
  • Familiarity with PKI, certificate lifecycle management and TLS/mTLS implementation.
  • Experience with ASD’s hardening guidance for Active Directory (including the joint ASD/CISA/NSA advisory on detecting and mitigating AD compromises).
  • Experience supporting system accreditation under the ISM and PSPF, including preparation of Security System Plans (SSPs) and security risk management documentation.
  • Relevant industry certifications such as GIAC (GSEC, GCIH, GCIA), CompTIA Security+/CySA+, Microsoft SC-200 or equivalent.
  • Experience with configuration management and patching platforms.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril’s Maritime Division seeks a Senior Executive Assistant to provide a wide variety of complex and professional-level executive administrative support duties in support of 2-3 VPs. This person will be in a position of high trust and serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external clients. The Senior Executive Assistant is expected to help drive cross-functional projects and initiatives critical to the Maritime Executives, while also serving as a liaison to senior management teams. The ideal candidate must be detail-oriented, have the ability to exercise good judgment in a variety of situations, action items with limited oversight, think critically, and offer solutions to problems with a high-level of professionalism and discretion. Being able to anticipate needs of the Executives, maintaining balance among competing priorities, and working well under pressure are essential skills to succeed in this role.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Scope and coordinate critical projects and special assignments on behalf of the Executives by prioritizing tasks, gaining cooperation from relevant stakeholders, monitoring progress, problem-solving, and making necessary adjustments to ensure timely completion
  • Plan and execute day-to-day administrative tasks to ensure a smooth workflow for the Executives
  • Serve as a representative of the Executives with an array of internal and external clients
  • Maintain the Executives schedules and act as the primary point of contact for accessing their time
  • Identify opportunities to create new processes and systems to effectively support the needs of the Executives and their teams
  • Produce and prepare reports for the Executives on a variety of topics, liaising with members of senior leadership and other members of the business
  • Draft and revise memos, emails, agendas, notes, reports, presentations, and other communications to the highest-quality standards
  • Plan, execute, oversee, and facilitate all logistical aspects for on-site VIP meetings and events involving the Executives. This includes preparing agendas, presentation materials, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure seamless execution
  • Manage sensitive matters with a high-level of confidentiality and discretion, especially decisions with significant impact on operations of the company
  • Own and arrange travel, accommodations, itineraries, and all correspondence related to arrangements as needed for the Executives

  • A minimum of 7 years experience supporting VP to C-Suite level executives in a fast-paced corporate environment
  • Proven ability to balance multi-departmental projects from conception to execution with little to no supervision
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. Approachable style and ability to effectively and professionally interface with high level executives, clients, employees, and business associates both internal and external
  • Strong organizational and time management skills. Proven experience in multitasking and working with multiple people and priorities, while delivering on high quality results and follow through
  • Demonstrates curiosity and a desire to understand the needs of the Executives
  • Highly trustworthy with ability to exercise sound discretion and function under highly ambiguous direction with constantly changing requirements
  • Proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information in a professional manner
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong Microsoft Office Suite skills
  • Proficient in scheduling meetings in multiple time zones
  • Experience as a project manager is highly preferred and desired

To maintain our independence and nonpartisan stance, we do not accept funding from the government or pharmaceutical companies. Our 2030 Goal: We are on a mission to partner with organizations that collectively reach 5 million patients of reproductive age. Recognition: We are a 2023 Audacious Project recipient, with our work featured in publications like Harvard Public Health , Bloomberg , and MedPage Today . We welcome individuals who are driven by impact and scale to join us in making equitable contraceptive access a reality for all. This is a fully benefited, full-time Upstream USA position that has been funded for 12 months from date of hire. There is the possibility of extension or conversion to a continuing position, contingent upon performance meeting the needs of the department, organizational need, and the continued availability of funding designated to support the position. Position Summary Upstream is scaling its use of AI across the organization: in program delivery and practice transformation, partnership success, development, finance, marketing and communications, and within the technology team itself. Reporting to the Director of Data, Analytics and Technology (DAT), this role is a hands-on, forward-deployed position that will embed directly with teams across Upstream to understand how their work gets done, identify where AI can help (and where it doesn’t), build working solutions, and stay with those solutions through adoption and measurement. This is a manager/builder/coach role: you will discover and prioritize use cases, prototype and deliver practical tools, and develop the training and resources that raise AI fluency organization-wide, all while leading tool evaluations, guardrails, and cost stewardship that keep our AI footprint responsible and sustainable. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Use Case Discovery & Prioritization Embed with teams across Upstream to understand end-to-end workflows, undocumented processes, and the manual work that slows them down. Identify, scope, and prioritize AI and automation opportunities based on business impact, feasibility, adoption potential, and risk. Translate ambiguous business problems into clearly defined use cases, solution hypotheses, and build plans. Exercise judgment about what is worth building — including recommending against AI when a simpler process change or an existing tool solves the problem. Solution Building & Delivery Design, build, test, and deploy practical AI-enabled solutions — prompts, skills, agents, automations, and lightweight applications — using Upstream’s approved AI tools, platforms and enterprise data. Prototype rapidly, put working solutions in front of real users quickly, and iterate based on feedback and observed usage. Build and curate a reusable library of prompts, skills, templates, and workflow components so that solutions compound rather than live in one person’s hands. Partner with DAT colleagues to transition validated prototypes into supported, production-ready solutions when scale or sensitivity warrants it. title: Senior Salesforce Administrator (GTM Systems) at Medely
full_text: The Company Medely is a high-growth series-C technology start-up reimagining the future of healthcare work by providing an on-demand marketplace and workforce management tools. With the support of top-tier investors, Medely has quickly become a go-to platform for healthcare professionals to instantly access high-paying jobs with the freedom and flexibility to work when and where they want. As a fully remote team of sharp, collaborative, and entrepreneurial individuals, we are dedicated to redefining the way healthcare workers and facilities work together to provide for patients. We are looking for passionate and skilled professionals to join our team and help us take on tough challenges in this fast-expanding healthcare industry segment. Join us in our mission to transform the healthcare staffing industry and improve patient lives! Build the Salesforce Experience Our Revenue Team Runs On Salesforce sits at the center of how Medely’s revenue organization operates. We’re looking for a Senior Salesforce Administrator who can do more than keep it running: someone who will make it cleaner, smarter, and easier for our teams to use as we scale. You’ll own the day-to-day health and continued evolution of Salesforce, along with key sales systems such as LeanData and Salesloft. You’ll work closely with Sales, Marketing, Account Management, Customer Success, and other cross-functional teams to understand where processes break down, identify opportunities before they become tickets, and build solutions that make people more effective. This role sits on the GTM Systems team within Revenue Operations and reports to our Head of GTM Systems. You’ll have meaningful ownership without operating in a silo - giving you an experienced partner to pressure-test ideas with while remaining the primary Salesforce administrator. This is a hands-on role for someone who treats Salesforce as a designed system, not a queue of requests. What You’ll Own Own Salesforce administration end to end — advanced configuration, security settings, and user roles; scalable solutions built on custom objects and advanced declarative automation; the object model managed as a designed system rather than an accumulation of requests. Own the definitions behind our customer and funnel metrics — a documented data dictionary, change control on the object model, and clear ownership of every field that feeds a reported number, with data hygiene (deduplication, matching and merge rules, validation rules, required-field enforcement) enforced at the point of entry so records enter clean. Run lead and account routing end to end — drive automation accuracy to 100% with monitoring that catches drift before a rep does, and instrument the funnel to show where deals stall and why. Oversee integrations and system architecture — third-party integrations, API configurations, and middleware across sales engagement, enrichment, customer success, support, and billing, sequenced toward a hub-and-spoke buildout and a central data lake; support minor development efforts, including Apex triggers and code-related troubleshooting. Build the reporting layer — advanced reports, dashboards, and exec-level views by vertical, so Sales, Marketing, Finance, CS, and Support leadership open the same report and reach the same conclusion. Serve as the single point of contact for GTM systems — triage and prioritize inbound requests across teams, decide what gets built in-house versus routed to our external development partner, support release and change management, and apply LLM-assisted workflows (ICP scoring, intent signals, account research, outreach personalization) that are measurable and repeatable. Who Thrives Here A minimum of 5+ years in Business Systems, RevOps, Sales Ops, Marketing Ops, or a comparable technical operations function, including hands-on Salesforce administration. Deep Salesforce data fluency. You know the object model cold, write SOQL, build cross-object formula fields and reports without a tutorial, and understand how CRM data has to be structured to be trustworthy downstream. Integration experience. You’ve owned a sync between Salesforce and at least one adjacent platform, including the field mapping and entity-resolution decisions that come with it. Cross-system diagnostic instinct. You’ve traced a reporting discrepancy to its root by inspecting the actual shape of the data, not by trusting a field name. Governance discipline. You document definitions before you build, version your changes, and enforce hygiene at the point of entry rather than by periodic cleanup — and you hold a standard when it would be faster not to. Ownership under ambiguity. You turn open-ended business questions into working systems with minimal specification, and you’re comfortable serving Sales, Marketing, Finance, CS, and Support at once — holding the line when a request conflicts with the data model without spending the relationship. What Sets You Apart Hands-on LeanData experience — lead/account matching, routing, and monitoring. Comfort supporting light development work: Apex triggers, process automation, and troubleshooting code-related issues. Warehouse or lake exposure — you’ve moved CRM, GTM, and post-sale data into Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar, and modeled it for reporting. AI fluency — LLMs in production for classification, extraction, summarization, and prompt chaining, with AI tooling woven into your own workflow. Consulting, agency, or early-stage background. Why Now? We already have a strong starting point, including detailed documentation of our systems and how they interact. The next opportunity is to build on that foundation: improve the Salesforce experience for our sales team, strengthen routing and data quality, and explore how AI can make our systems and workflows more effective. You won’t be joining to inherit a backlog and close tickets. You’ll help decide what should be improved, shape how Salesforce and our sales technology evolve, and gradually expand your ownership as our GTM systems become more sophisticated. Why Medely: Benefits & Perks Competitive Compensation: Based on experience and performance Long-term Incentives: 401k Healthcare Benefits: Full suite of benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance Flexibility: We believe that work/life balance is important, so we offer flexible and unlimited PTO Paid parental leave Purpose: Join a growing mission-oriented startup that is modernizing the healthcare industry nationally! Ownership: Drive meaningful business impact on a team you’ll help build and define! Remote: Work in a digital environment with all the tools to achieve your work as though you were in the office! We’re an equal opportunity employer to all. We interview and hire applicants of all backgrounds, orientations, expressions, and identities. Work location is flexible if approved by Medely. Medely does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. We consider any resume (CV) or biography received from an agency or outside recruiter without prior approval from a member of the Medely Human Resources or Recruiting team to be unsolicited and gratuitous, and such submissions will not be recognized by Medely for purposes of “ownership” of the candidate. We are an E-Verify company.

title: Senior AI Researcher at Recursion
full_text: Your work will change lives. Including your own. The Impact You’ll Make: Human biology stems from four billion years of evolution, which creates a proliferation of complexity and heterogeneity. The combinatorial explosion of biological hypotheses easily surpasses the number of atoms in the universe. Meanwhile, medical discovery advances at the snail pace of clinical trials, each taking years and costing over $100 million. As we enter the era of precision health and try to tailor treatments for each individual, continuing on today’s discovery processes is clearly unsustainable. With the confluence of digital transformation and intelligence revolution, we have an unprecedented opportunity to develop a unifying biomedical world model by bridging virtual patient and virtual cell, and turning real-world data into a discovery engine to close the loop of clinical care and drug discovery. As a Senior AI Researcher, you will join our cross-functional team of top-notch scientists, engineers, and drug hunters in the quest of scalable biomedical discovery. You will work at the forefront of AI-powered drug discovery, advancing frontier research and end-to-end applications across discovery, design, and translation. The Team You’ll Join: Recursion is a pioneer in AI-native drug discovery. In the past decade, we have built an unparalleled array of infrastructures across drug discovery and clinical development, operating one of the largest AI compute clusters in biopharma, and spearheading industrial-scale phenomics for perturbation data generation at cellular resolution, long before “virtual cell” entered the mainstream. United under the mission of “decoding biology to radically improve lives”, we offer a unique vibrant environment that features frontier research, industrialized wet and dry labs, and real-world delivery, with close feedback loops and rapid iterations, much like a lean startup. You will join fellow experts across research and engineering, biology and medicine, business and operation, who are similarly committed to accelerating biomedical discovery and democratizing precision health for everyone in the globe. The Experience You Will Need: PhD in ML, NLP, computer vision, or the equivalent practical experience Passionate about real-world applications and impact Strong verbal and writing communication skills 3+ years of frontier AI research experience Experience with large datasets and cross-functional AI projects Experience in biomedicine and drug discovery a plus; willingness to learn a must! #LI-DNI The Values We Hope You Share: We act boldly with integrity. We are unconstrained in our thinking, take calculated risks, and push boundaries, but never at the expense of ethics, science, or trust. We care deeply and engage directly. title: B2B - Director, Growth Marketing at CookUnity
full_text: About CookUnity: Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul. Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting. About the Team CookUnity Business delivers chef-crafted meals tailored to the teams, patients, and clients our partners serve. Across Healthcare and Corporate—including Smart Fridge as a Corporate offering—we replace processed food service with fresh, dietitian-reviewed meals from award-winning chefs. Our marketing team turns that value into a clear go-to-market strategy that builds credibility, creates demand, and drives measurable commercial growth. The Role The Director, Growth Marketing, B2B will lead the B2B marketing function and own the go-to-market strategy across CookUnity Business. This leader will partner closely with Sales to define and prioritize our ideal customer profiles, sharpen our messaging, build scalable lead-generation and outreach programs, and directly influence pipeline and revenue. This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role. You will set the roadmap, own the budget and performance targets, and lead the team responsible for content, paid media, CRM, events, organic channels, and website optimization. You will develop the existing team and build the additional capabilities the function needs as the business grows. The ideal candidate understands how B2B buyers move from awareness to purchase, can translate that insight into differentiated vertical-specific GTM motions, and knows how to create strong operating rhythms with Sales. You will be the head of B2B Growth Marketing and will hold the function accountable for qualified pipeline and revenue. Responsibilities GTM Strategy and Revenue Growth Own the end-to-end B2B go-to-market strategy across Healthcare and Corporate, aligning marketing priorities with commercial goals. Partner with Sales leadership to understand the sales motion, define and prioritize ICPs, identify buyer needs, and translate those insights into differentiated messaging and campaigns. Build the full-funnel demand-generation roadmap, from awareness and lead generation through pipeline creation, conversion, expansion, and retention. Establish goals and KPIs for marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline, conversion, acquisition efficiency, and revenue impact. Own the B2B marketing budget and allocate investment based on performance and business priorities. Create a strong operating cadence with Sales, including shared pipeline reviews, campaign planning, lead-quality feedback, and ongoing optimization. Demand Generation and Commercial Execution Develop integrated, vertical-specific programs across paid media, organic and social channels, CRM, events, partnerships, website, and sales outreach. Build lead-generation and outreach strategies that create qualified demand and help Sales engage priority accounts effectively. Lead content strategy, paid media, and campaign execution through the team, ensuring every channel supports the broader GTM strategy. Translate ICP and buyer insights into value propositions, case studies, thought leadership, campaigns, and sales enablement materials that accelerate deals and improve win rates. Oversee lifecycle programs, website conversion, SEO, vertical-specific landing pages, and field marketing. Identify and test new channels and tactics—including retargeting, out-of-home advertising, and direct mail—based on customer insight and performance data. Partner with the B2C team on PR and shared opportunities where CookUnity’s broader brand can strengthen B2B growth. Analytics and Optimization Build on CookUnity Business’s marketing dashboard to create clear visibility into performance, pipeline, revenue, and spend. Connect insights across Salesforce, paid channels, CRM, website, and other data sources to identify bottlenecks and optimize investment. Use attribution, experimentation, and customer feedback to prioritize initiatives and scale the strategies with the greatest commercial impact. Communicate performance clearly to senior leadership, including what is working, what is not, and where the team should focus next. Team and Cross-Functional Leadership Lead, coach, and develop the existing B2B marketing team while defining the structure and capabilities needed for the next stage of growth. Hire and build the team beyond its current structure, creating clear ownership, high standards, and accountability. Lead the broader cross-functional marketing effort, ensuring functional owners execute against a unified GTM roadmap. Partner with Operations, Partnerships, Brand, Creative, Data, Product, Tech, and vertical leaders to connect marketing strategy with customer needs and business priorities. Influence at every level by sharing insights, presenting results, and championing B2B marketing as a strategic growth driver. Qualifications 8+ years of experience in B2B growth marketing, demand generation, or go-to-market leadership, ideally within healthcare, corporate or enterprise services, or another multi-vertical business. Proven track record building and scaling B2B GTM programs that generate measurable pipeline and revenue. Deep understanding of ICP development, segmentation, positioning, messaging, lead generation, sales motions, and funnel optimization. Strong partnership with Sales, with experience creating shared goals, feedback loops, and programs that improve pipeline quality and conversion. Experience leading multi-channel programs across content, paid media, CRM, events, organic and social, website, and sales enablement. Demonstrated experience developing high-performing teams and building new capabilities as a function scales. Strong analytical judgment and fluency with funnel, pipeline, attribution, and budget data. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to align creative, commercial, operational, and technical teams. A true player-coach who can set strategy, lead a team, and personally drive the highest-priority work. Startup or high-growth experience preferred. Ability to leverage generative AI to increase the quality and speed of work. Commercially Minded: You understand customers, sales motions, and the connection between marketing decisions, pipeline, and revenue. title: Supply Chain Logistics Manager at Minted
full_text: We are looking for a Supply Chain Logistics Manager to lead Minted’s end-to-end transportation network—from inbound freight originating with overseas suppliers through final-mile delivery to our DTC customers and wholesale partners. This role will own logistics performance, cost, carrier strategy and relationships, and continuous improvement, ensuring our network delivers the right balance of speed, reliability, cost, and scalability. You will partner closely with our fulfillment network, overseas vendors, 3PLs, Customer Service, technology teams, and internal business partners. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, with an expectation of working onsite 3 days per week. You will: DTC & Last-Mile Logistics Own and optimize Minted’s DTC parcel network across carriers, service levels, fulfillment locations, and product categories. Manage carrier performance, relationships, and contracts, including rate and contract negotiations, SLA management, and evaluation of new carriers and services. Analyze shipping costs, service levels, surcharges, routing, and package characteristics to improve delivery performance and reduce cost per package. Partner with fulfillment and technology teams to optimize carrier selection, shipping-service logic, and end-to-end shipment visibility. Serve as the primary logistics partner to Customer Service, ensuring time-sensitive and high-priority customer shipments receive appropriate escalation and resolution. Peak Planning & Execution Lead transportation readiness for Peak, translating business forecasts into carrier- and service-level volume forecasts and capacity requirements. Coordinate with carriers and fulfillment partners to ensure appropriate pickup schedules, capacity, and contingency plans are in place at each location. Monitor Peak performance and proactively communicate shipping forecasts, service risks, capacity constraints, surcharge changes, and cost implications to the business. International & Inbound Logistics Own inbound transportation from overseas suppliers through delivery to Minted fulfillment locations, distribution centers, and wholesale destinations. Manage freight forwarders, customs brokers, 3PLs, and overseas vendors to ensure shipments are planned, documented, tracked, and delivered on time. Optimize ocean, air, and domestic inbound freight based on cost, lead time, and inventory requirements, including consolidation, mode selection, and total landed cost. Maintain strong working knowledge of Incoterms, customs processes, duties, international shipping documentation, and trade-compliance requirements. Wholesale & Distribution Logistics Manage logistics requirements for wholesale and retail programs, including routing guides, labeling, appointments, EDI, and delivery compliance. Monitor and resolve freight-related chargebacks and deductions, and ensure logistics readiness for new customers, programs, and product launches. Analytics & Continuous Improvement Own logistics KPIs, transportation forecasts, and cost-to-serve analysis, translating data into actionable operational and financial improvements. Identify and execute initiatives that reduce transportation cost, improve transit times and reliability, and strengthen network resilience. Partner with Engineering, Product, and IT to automate workflows, improve data accuracy, and enhance shipment visibility. Serve as the cross-functional voice of logistics , ensuring transportation considerations, risks, and costs are incorporated into business decisions. You have: 5+ years of experience in transportation, logistics, or supply chain operations, with meaningful experience in both DTC parcel / last-mile shipping and international inbound logistics . Deep knowledge of the U.S. parcel ecosystem, including national and regional carriers, service levels, pricing, surcharges, and carrier performance management. Experience managing carrier contracts, transportation pricing, and commercial negotiations. Hands-on experience with international freight, including ocean and air transportation, freight forwarders, customs brokers, Incoterms, and inbound coordination. Experience planning carrier capacity and transportation operations for high-volume seasonal or Peak periods. Experience with multi-node fulfillment, 3PL, and wholesale or retail distribution environments. Strong analytical and financial skills, with experience using data to evaluate transportation costs, forecast demand, and drive cost and service improvements. Strong operational judgment and cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to identify risks early and drive issues through resolution. Our employment offers fall between the minimum and midpoint of the range to allow for continued salary growth during your employment at Minted. The upper half of the range accommodates this growth and supports our intention to create an environment that encourages lasting relationships between Minted and our employees. Minted utilizes a market-based compensation model with four geographic tiers. This role is eligible for bonus and stock options. We reserve the right to withdraw candidates who misrepresent their identity, experience, or qualifications at any stage of the process. Notice of AI Use in Employment Decisions: We use AI-powered tools, including Brainner AI, to support our hiring and employment processes. These tools help assess job-related qualifications and improve efficiency, but all decisions involve human review. About Minted: Artists shape culture. They spark conversation, create connection, and bring beauty into the world. Minted is where they come together to reach further. Our marketplace empowers a thriving community of independent artists to sell and scale their work. We nurture self-expression, cultivate community, and bring the best in visual art to a global audience. We’re building a new way to discover the world’s best creative talent. We’re here for the emerging talent ready to take off, the local favorites ready to grow, and the established artists ready to dream bigger. At Minted, our people don’t just believe in the power of art–we live it. We have our finger on the pulse of what’s new and now. We’re obsessed with great design, art, and interiors. We’re in galleries, at fairs, and constantly finding inspiration online. We seek undiscovered talent that deserves to stand up and stand out. We connect with artists that have something to say, and we collaborate to amplify their work.  The Minted community’s art, stationery, and textiles products have reached over 75 million homes worldwide. Our marketplace brings the best in independent design to consumers everywhere. We recognize the challenges independent artists face, and we leverage our resources to level the playing field and create a platform that gives artists the freedom to develop their craft and grow their business. We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA and currently employ 350+ full-time employees, plus additional temporary workers during the holiday season. We have raised over $300M from top-tier investors including Benchmark Capital, T. Rowe Price, Permira, Ridge Ventures, Technology Crossover Ventures, and Norwest Venture Partners.  Angel investors include Marissa Mayer, Jeremy Stoppelman, Julia & Kevin Hartz, Yishan Wong, and more. Minted is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to inclusion and diversity. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and will consider all qualified applicants for employment in accordance with all state, local, and federal laws. Using its crowdsourcing technology, consumers are empowered to vote for the designs they love and want to see sold, ensuring that Minted always sells continuously fresh and trend-forward product. The winning designs are manufactured by Minted, enabling artists from around the world to share and sell their work while letting Minted do the rest. Since launch in 2007, the company has expanded to serve consumers in new categories including wall art, textiles, digital content and home decor, as well as serve major retailers and consumer products brands with data-backed design through licensing and wholesale partnerships. title: Junior Systems Administrator at fusionSpan
full_text: fusionSpan is a dynamic, fast-paced hybrid and remote work environment that prioritizes innovation, trust, and community in everything we do. This is an early-career position designed for a high-potential individual who is eager to manage and evolve the backbone of our business operations. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and software integration. You will be responsible for the health, security, and connectivity of our core platforms, ensuring that data flows cleanly across our ecosystem. A note on experience with our specific platforms. This is a technical role and it requires real technical ability. You need to be able to read and write code, reason about how systems talk to each other, and work confidently in a command line, a log file, and an API. What you do not need is prior experience in Salesforce, AWS, or any other product on this page. Those are learnable, and we will teach them to you. Requirements Gathering: Sit with stakeholders across the business, ask the questions that surface what they actually need (not just what they asked for), and turn that into a clear set of requirements. Solution Design: Evaluate options, weigh tradeoffs, and recommend an approach. Then build it, test it, and see it through. Documentation: Maintain clear, up-to-date technical documentation for system architecture, integration mappings, and workflow logic. Systems & Cloud Administration Salesforce Administration: Act as a junior admin for the Salesforce environment, managing user permissions, configuration changes, and custom object maintenance. Integrations & Automation API Management: Work directly with REST/SOAP APIs to maintain and troubleshoot integrations between diverse software platforms. Technical Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve integration failures or API bottlenecks to ensure high system availability. A solid understanding of API architecture: what REST and SOAP are, how authentication works, what a payload looks like, and how two systems exchange data. title: Senior Manager, Global Sourcing & Supply at Minted
full_text: The Role: We are looking for a Senior Manager, Global Sourcing & Supply to lead the strategy, development, and performance of Minted’s global supplier network, ensuring we have the right partners, capabilities, economics, capacity, compliance, and supply plans to support our current business and future product growth. This role will partner closely with Product Development, Business Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Logistics, Planning, Finance, and Legal to shape sourcing and supply strategies from early product development through commercialization, production, and ongoing supply. You will lead key supplier relationships and commercial negotiations, oversee sourcing and supply planning across the portfolio, and proactively manage cost, capacity, quality, inventory, compliance, and supply risk. This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who combines strong commercial and strategic judgment with deep sourcing and supply expertise and is comfortable moving between long-term strategy and hands-on problem-solving. You will: Lead global sourcing and supply strategies across assigned product categories, ensuring the supplier network has the capabilities, capacity, cost structure, quality, compliance, and resilience needed to support business objectives. Develop and evolve the global supplier portfolio, including identifying capability gaps, evaluating new sourcing markets and manufacturing partners, and leading the qualification and onboarding of strategic suppliers. Partner with Product Development and Business Operations early in the product development process to inform supplier selection, manufacturability, target costs, materials, lead times, and commercialization strategies. Provide oversight of new product development and commercialization, ensuring complex or strategically important programs are effectively transitioned from concept through scaled production. Own strategic supplier relationships and lead major commercial negotiations, including pricing frameworks, MOQs, lead times, payment terms, capacity commitments, and other key commercial terms. Develop and lead cost-management and value-engineering strategies across the portfolio, identifying opportunities to improve product economics through supplier negotiations, materials, manufacturing methods, product specifications, sourcing decisions, and landed-cost optimization. Provide oversight of supply and inventory planning across the portfolio, ensuring demand forecasts are translated into appropriate purchasing, production, and inventory strategies that balance availability, lead times, capacity, MOQs, and supply risk. Partner with Planning and Supply Chain teams to identify longer-term demand, capacity, and inventory risks and ensure appropriate mitigation plans are in place. Lead supplier capacity and production-readiness planning, particularly for major product launches, seasonal demand, and Peak, ensuring sufficient materials, tooling, labor, equipment, and contingency plans are in place. Own the compliance framework for the global supplier network, ensuring suppliers meet Minted’s requirements related to responsible sourcing, product and regulatory compliance, documentation, testing, and other applicable standards. Partner with Logistics, Finance, Legal, and external customs and trade partners to ensure compliance with import/export requirements, customs regulations, product classification, country-of-origin requirements, duties, tariffs, and required shipping documentation. Monitor changes in tariffs, duties, trade regulations, and sourcing-country requirements; assess potential cost and supply implications and develop mitigation strategies as appropriate. Proactively identify and mitigate global sourcing and supply risks, including supplier concentration, capacity constraints, material availability, long lead times, geopolitical exposure, trade and compliance risk, tariffs, quality issues, and other potential disruptions. Establish and manage supplier performance expectations across cost, quality, delivery, responsiveness, capacity, compliance, and continuous improvement, using scorecards, business reviews, corrective-action plans, and executive escalation as appropriate. Partner with Quality to ensure appropriate supplier quality systems, product specifications, testing, inspection standards, and corrective-action processes are established and maintained. Partner with Logistics and Supply Chain to ensure sourcing and production strategies appropriately account for freight, lead times, shipment timing, inventory requirements, customs and import requirements, duties and tariffs, and overall landed-cost considerations. Build strong relationships with supplier ownership and senior leadership, creating productive long-term partnerships while maintaining clear accountability for performance. Identify emerging manufacturing technologies, materials, supplier capabilities, and sourcing opportunities that can enable product innovation, improve economics, or strengthen Minted’s supply network. Establish clear operating rhythms, processes, and visibility across sourcing, development, production, inventory, compliance, and supplier performance to enable proactive decision-making and escalation. Provide leadership, coaching, prioritization, and development for members of the Global Sourcing & Supply team. Travel internationally as required for supplier visits, strategic business reviews, product development, production reviews, and sourcing activities. You have: 8+ years of progressive experience in global sourcing, supply management, product development, manufacturing, or related supply chain roles. Significant experience working directly with global manufacturers and managing complex supplier relationships, ideally in consumer products, home, stationery, gifting, retail, or other design-led categories. Demonstrated experience developing and executing sourcing strategies across multiple products, categories, or suppliers. Strong commercial experience, including strategic supplier negotiations, cost management, pricing, MOQs, payment terms, and value engineering. Strong understanding of supply and inventory planning, demand forecasting, production planning, capacity management, and purchase-order processes. Deep understanding of product development and manufacturing processes from concept through commercialization and scaled production. Experience managing supplier compliance and working knowledge of international trade requirements, including customs, duties, tariffs, country of origin, product classification, and import documentation. Demonstrated ability to assess and manage supplier performance, capacity, quality, compliance, and supply risk. Strong analytical and financial acumen with the ability to evaluate tradeoffs across cost, landed cost, quality, inventory, speed, innovation, compliance, and risk. Excellent relationship-management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior internal stakeholders and supplier leadership. Experience leading, coaching, or developing team members. Comfortable operating both strategically and hands-on in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities. Willingness to travel internationally. Compensation: The compensation range for the role applies to employment offers from Minted. Our employment offers fall between the minimum and midpoint of the range to allow for continued salary growth during your employment at Minted. The upper half of the range accommodates this growth and supports our intention to create an environment that encourages lasting relationships between Minted and our employees. Minted utilizes a market-based compensation model with four geographic tiers. Final compensation is determined based on the candidate’s primary work location, defined as their residence within 60 miles of a metropolitan area: Geo 2: Boston, MA; Washington, DC; Chicago, IL; Seattle, WA; Austin, TX; Atlanta, GA; Portland, OR - $114,429 - $150,188 Geo 3: All other U.S. metro locations - $105,005 - $137,820 Salaries will vary based on various factors, including but not limited to professional and academic experience, associated job responsibilities, and/or other business or organizational needs. This role is eligible for bonus and stock options. Benefits: Benefits will be effective on the first of each month following your initial hire date. - Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits - Employer-Funded Health Savings Account - 10 Paid Holidays - Paid Time Off and Sick Leave - Paid Parental Leave - Monthly Gym/Wellness Reimbursement - 401(k) retirement savings plan - Employer-Funded Commuter Benefits - Employee Discount - Friends and Family Discount DISCLAIMER: We verify identity at the start of interviews to ensure fairness and security. These tools help assess job-related qualifications and improve efficiency, but all decisions involve human review. About Minted: Artists shape culture. They spark conversation, create connection, and bring beauty into the world. Minted is where they come together to reach further. Our marketplace empowers a thriving community of independent artists to sell and scale their work. We nurture self-expression, cultivate community, and bring the best in visual art to a global audience. We’re building a new way to discover the world’s best creative talent. We’re here for the emerging talent ready to take off, the local favorites ready to grow, and the established artists ready to dream bigger. We’re in galleries, at fairs, and constantly finding inspiration online. We seek undiscovered talent that deserves to stand up and stand out. We connect with artists that have something to say, and we collaborate to amplify their work.  The Minted community’s art, stationery, and textiles products have reached over 75 million homes worldwide. Our marketplace brings the best in independent design to consumers everywhere. We recognize the challenges independent artists face, and we leverage our resources to level the playing field and create a platform that gives artists the freedom to develop their craft and grow their business. We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA and currently employ 350+ full-time employees, plus additional temporary workers during the holiday season. En autonomie, vous accompagnerez de manière opérationnelle l’ensemble de nos métiers et filiales sur les enjeux cruciaux liés à la protection des données personnelles et à l'encadrement de l'Intelligence Artificielle. Au sein de la Direction Juridique, vous pourrez également être amené(e) à prêter main-forte sur d'autres thématiques transverses relatives à la conformité globale du Groupe. À ce titre, vous intervenez notamment sur les missions suivantes : 1) Gouvernance & Suivi de la Conformité Contribuer à la définition de la feuille de route de conformité (Data & IA) et en assurer le déploiement à l'échelle du Groupe. Rédiger, déployer et tenir à jour l'ensemble des politiques et documents légaux liés à la Data et à l'IA (Privacy Policies, politiques cookies, chartes IA internes, CGU, procédures de gestion de crise), en tenant compte des spécificités du secteur du jeu vidéo (données de mineurs, AdTech, outils anti-triche). Élaborer un reporting régulier et précis sur l'état de la conformité de votre périmètre pour la direction du Groupe PulluP. Être l’interlocuteur des autres autorités de contrôle concernées (CNIL, DGCCRF, ARCOM, ANSSI, etc.). Assurer une veille réglementaire et jurisprudentielle proactive (Data & IA) pour anticiper les impacts sur les activités du groupe. 2) Conformité RGPD & Opérationnel Gérer la conformité des traitements de données au quotidien : tenue et mise à jour du registre, réalisation des analyses d'impact (AIPD), audits internes, identification des risques et suivi des plans de remédiation. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes techniques et la sécurité des systèmes d'information (DSI/RSSI) sur la sécurisation des données pour assurer la gestion des incidents de sécurité (incluant la préparation des notifications aux autorités) dans les délais impartis. Traiter les demandes d'exercice de droits dans les délais impartis. Accompagner opérationnellement les équipes dans la mise œuvre de projet impliquant le traitement de données personnelles en procédant à l'évaluation des impacts et risques associés (privacy by design). 3) Déploiement & Sécurisation de l'IA (AI Act) Accompagner opérationnellement les équipes dans le déploiement de leurs projets d'Intelligence Artificielle en procédant à l'évaluation des risques associés (compliance by design). Mettre en œuvre et documenter les processus de conformité IA (contrôles, traçabilité) pour garantir le respect de l'AI Act et des réglementations applicables. 4) Conseil, Négociation & Sensibilisation Accompagnement des équipes Marketing sur les sujets AdTech (cookies, pixels, SDK, ciblage publicitaire, etc.). Conseiller les équipes opérationnelles et négocier les clauses contractuelles relatives à la Data et à l'IA avec nos fournisseurs et partenaires. Concevoir et animer des actions de sensibilisation et de formation à destination des différentes directions du groupe. Ce que l’on attend de vous : Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master 2 en droit du numérique, droit des nouvelles technologies, protection des données et/ou spécialisation DPO et disposez d’une expérience confirmée de 7 ans minimum en protection des données (une expérience en tant que DPO ou DPO adjoint est fortement appréciée). L'obtention d'une certification reconnue (type IAPP : CIPP/E, CIPM) constitue un véritable atout. Vous disposez d’une excellente maîtrise opérationnelle du RGPD et des réglementations liées à la protection des données, et d’une connaissance pratique des réglementations internationales (CCPA/CPRA, UK GDPR, PIPEDA, etc.). Vous maîtrisez des enjeux liés au traitement des données des mineurs et aux mécanismes de vérification d'âge. Vous faites preuve de solides connaissances de la réglementation relative à l’encadrement de l’IA (AI Act / RIA) et des enjeux de gouvernance des systèmes d'IA. Vous maîtrisez le français et l’anglais dans un contexte professionnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral (rédaction et négociation autonome de contrats). Vous disposez d’excellentes compétences rédactionnelles. title: Sr. Contract Attorney at Colibri Group
full_text: At Colibri, culture is a critical part of our collective success, and we live our values everyday: Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork and Curiosity. These values guide our interactions with each other, our customers, and the community as a whole. We have a rich and storied history.
