Today, the company’s family of brands are the leading online professional education platforms in their respective end-markets. We proudly serve >1 million customers annually and employ more than 1,500 mission-aligned professionals. To learn more, please visit: www.colibrigroup.com Position Overview: Colibri Group is seeking a practical, business-oriented Commercial Contracts Attorney to join its Legal, Regulatory and Compliance team. Reporting to the General Counsel, this attorney will play a lead role in the review, drafting and negotiation of a broad range of commercial agreements supporting Colibri’s businesses and corporate functions. The role is intentionally broad. Colibri contracts both as a provider of products and services and as a purchaser of technology, services, content and other goods and services. The successful candidate therefore should be an experienced commercial generalist who is comfortable moving between customer-facing and vendor-side agreements rather than specializing in a single contract type or business model. In addition to handling commercial transactions, this attorney will help improve and bring greater structure to Colibri’s contracting function. This includes developing templates and negotiation playbooks, establishing consistent contracting and escalation practices, improving contract intake and lifecycle-management processes, and helping Colibri more effectively use its AI-enabled contract management technology. The Commercial Contracts Attorney will also supervise and develop members of the contracts team, including Contract Specialists, and will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Finance, Procurement, Privacy, Information Security, Technology, Product, Marketing, Human Resources and other business functions. What You’ll Do Commercial Contracting • Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements on both the customer and vendor sides of transactions, including master services agreements, statements of work, order forms, subscription and technology agreements, software and SaaS agreements, professional and consulting services agreements, licensing agreements, content agreements, marketing agreements, distribution and referral agreements, data processing agreements, confidentiality agreements and other commercial arrangements. • Independently manage routine and moderately complex commercial negotiations from intake through execution, identifying material legal and business risks and developing practical solutions that enable the business to achieve its objectives. • Exercise sound judgment in determining when an issue can be resolved within established parameters and when a matter should be escalated to the General Counsel or another subject-matter expert. • Translate business objectives and operational requirements into clear contractual terms and explain contractual risks and alternatives to business stakeholders in practical, understandable terms. • Partner closely with business teams to understand the commercial context of transactions and distinguish material legal and business risks from issues that do not warrant delaying or disrupting a transaction. full_text: About Niche Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. About The Role We are looking for an experienced, analytically rigorous, and collaborative Senior Marketing Analyst to own how Niche measures and improves the performance of its marketing engine, on both sides of the marketplace. This is a senior individual contributor role on the Analytics team, embedded day to day with the marketing and growth teams and reporting to the Manager of Operational Analytics. The Senior Marketing Analyst is the analytical owner of two connected domains: B2B marketing and pipeline analytics: how marketing-sourced demand becomes qualified leads, opportunities, and closed business. B2C growth and registration analytics: how students and parents find Niche across acquisition channels, register, and convert into engaged users. This is a deeply embedded role. You will sit in marketing, B2B, SEO, and lifecycle meetings and workflows, develop first-hand awareness of how data is actually being used, where the gaps are, and what’s needed before it becomes a problem. You will be a strategic partner to marketing leadership rather than a reporting function: proactively surfacing insights, pairing them with recommendations and clear next steps, and staying with the work through the decision it informs. What You Will Do B2B Marketing & Pipeine Analytics Build the measurement foundation for how Niche markets to schools and districts: define which metrics matter, how they are calculated, and where the reporting lives, so the business can see what is actually working Bring rigor to questions such as which channels and campaigns produce pipeline that closes, what a marketing-sourced lead is actually worth, and where demand generation investment should go next Develop leading-indicator reporting that gives marketing and sales leadership early signal on pipeline health rather than a retrospective read Own the B2B attribution model in Marketo Measure, including touchpoint and channel definitions and the data flow between Marketo, Salesforce, and Snowflake. Partner with Marketing and Sales to keep campaign tracking and lead and opportunity attribution reliable over time Support new business forecasting and pipeline reviews with clear, documented methodology and honest confidence levels B2C Growth & Registration Analytics Own registration and acquisition measurement end to end: registration funnel performance, campaign and channel attribution, and the connection between how a user arrived and what they went on to do on the platform Measure paid acquisition efficiency: cost per registration, cost per qualified lead, and how spend translates into users who actually convert. Partner with Growth Marketing on media mix and budget decisions, and build the forecasts behind them Serve as the analytical partner to Growth Marketing and Lifecycle: size opportunities, design and read out growth tests, troubleshoot tracking, and maintain the reporting the team runs on day to day Build and maintain the marketing dashboards and self-serve views that let growth, lifecycle, and leadership answer their own recurring questions Own organic search analytics: measure performance by page type, path, and traffic source (profiles, rankings, entity search), and quantify the impact of product decisions and algorithm updates Build the monitoring and daily reporting that surfaces organic traffic shifts before they become surprises, and keep traffic definitions consistent across dashboards and the semantic layer Partner with Product and Data Engineering to define the event tracking and data models this measurement depends on Analytical Rigor & Influence Model analytical rigor on marketing data: reproducible SQL, documented methodology, validated results, and a clear line between correlation and causation Review and pressure-test analyses from across the analytics team and from business partners, and sharpen how findings are framed and communicated Act as the subject matter expert on acquisition-funnel data sources and methodology: when analyses from Business or Product Analytics start at the top of the funnel, make sure they start from the right source, the right definition, and a method that will hold Mentor analysts informally and share techniques across the analytics team Partner with Data Engineering as the voice of the business: write clear measurement requirements, contribute directly to dbt models and the company-wide self-serve semantic layer, and QA what gets shipped Champion AI-assisted analytics in your own work and help colleagues adopt it by building and maintaining the skills, workflows, and context that make these tools reliable on Niche’s data Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership with clear insight and a clear “so what” What We Are Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Marketing, or a related field. A Master’s degree is a plus 5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, data analytics, or a closely related data function. Demonstrated experience owning marketing measurement end to end, from tracking implementation through to reporting and recommendation. Hands-on experience with consumer acquisition data: web analytics and paid media platforms (GA4, Meta, Google Ads, or equivalent), including campaign and channel attribution and its limitations. Direct experience with B2B marketing and pipeline analytics: lead and MQL lifecycle, multi-touch attribution, campaign and channel contribution to pipeline, and conversion through to closed business. Experience working with marketing automation, CRM, and attribution data (e.g., Marketo, Marketo Measure, Salesforce) and diagnosing problems in how they connect. Proven ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insight for non-technical stakeholders, and to say plainly when the data won’t support the question. Experience in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with shifting priorities, and resilience in the face of ambiguity and change. Senior proficiency in SQL; comfortable writing, reviewing, and troubleshooting complex queries independently. Strong proficiency in data visualization and dashboarding platforms such as Streamlit, Tableau, Looker, or similar. Working knowledge of a modern data stack: Snowflake, dbt, and version-controlled analytics work. Comfortable with experimentation and quantitative methods: designing and reading out A/B and growth tests, sizing effects honestly, and knowing when a result is signal and when it isn’t. A genuine practitioner of AI-assisted analytics: comfortable using tools like Claude Code in your own work, and rigorous about validating what comes back. Comfort operating as a senior IC: influencing without authority, working self-directed on complex and ambiguous problems, and mentoring peers. Nice to Have Experience with Python or R. Direct experience with SEO analytics: indexation, page-level organic performance, and technical SEO measurement. Experience contributing to a semantic layer or self-serve metrics layer. Background in SaaS, education technology, or marketplace analytics environments. Experience in the education sector or working with schools and colleges. title: Financial Analyst- 12 month contract at Mejuri
full_text: Since 2015, Mejuri has reimagined what fine jewelry can be in a modern world—shifting it from a traditional gift to to a personal choice rooted in self-expression. Founded by third-generation jeweller Noura Sakkijha, the brand was built on a simple idea: fine jewelry shouldn’t require a special occasion, and it should never come with guilt. It’s about celebrating yourself—your style, your life, your everyday. Mejuri meets customers where they are—online, in app, and through a growing global retail footprint of 58+ stores worldwide. Mejuri is also deeply committed to doing things the right way, with responsible sourcing, sustainable practices, and philanthropic initiatives that reflect our values and long-term vision. Overview (Financial Analyst- 12 month contract) The Financial Analyst owns the numbers behind Mejuri’s planning cycle: building the annual budget and the quarterly and monthly forecasts, then tracking actuals against them across departments, stores, and the consolidated business. Forecasts and budgets only matter if someone is watching how reality diverges from them — that ongoing read is what this role exists to provide. You’ll prepare the reporting packages that give business leaders a clear view of their financials and headcount, with variance analysis that surfaces risk and opportunity before it shows up in results. You’ll run the weekly cash flow report for the company, catch data issues at the source with Payroll, and work directly with business partners across departments who bring their numbers to you before they bring them to anyone else. You’ll join a small FP&A team, where one person’s analysis often reaches a business leader directly, with no layer of review between the work and the decision it informs. What You’ll Do Planning & Forecasting Budget and forecast accuracy — The annual budget and monthly and quarterly forecasts reflect where the business actually stands. You build them across departments and stores, then monitor results against plan and flag where they diverge. Cash flow reporting — The company gets an accurate weekly read on cash position. You assist in preparing this report on a consistent schedule, alongside ad hoc analysis as it comes up. Process improvement — Budgeting and forecasting get faster and more reliable over time. You look for where the current process breaks down and fix it, rather than working around it each cycle. Reporting & Business Partnering Reporting packages — Business leaders see their financial results and headcount clearly, with the variance analysis to explain why. You prepare these packages and flag the risks and opportunities in them. Decision support — Business partners get an answer that changes what they decide, not just a summary of what happened. You analyze past and projected financial impact to support their calls. Fact-based challenge — Assumptions get tested before they become the forecast. You question inputs that don’t hold up and push back with the numbers when they say something different. Systems fluency — Business partners get a better process, not just a report. You build a working knowledge of Mejuri’s systems, processes, and financial statements, and use it to find where efficiency is possible. What You’ll Bring Finance education — A Bachelor of Business Administration with a specialization in Finance or Accounting. FP&A experience — 1–3 years in FP&A or financial reporting; retail or CPG industry experience is an asset, as is progress toward a CPA, CFA, or CBV designation. Advanced Excel — Comfort building complex formulas and financial models, and handling large volumes of data without losing accuracy. Systems aptitude — A demonstrated ability to pick up new systems quickly and use their full capabilities, not just the basics. Self-direction — You take initiative without being asked and follow through on what you commit to. Relationship-building — Strong written communication and the ability to build working relationships across functions and levels, including with non-finance and executive stakeholders. Benefits at Mejuri: A minimum of four weeks vacation, plus personal days and three religious/cultural observance days. A hybrid work model for all corporate roles ‘Mejuri Passport’ which allows employees who meet specific criteria to work in other locations for one month per year. Comprehensive medical and dental benefits, including mental health coverage, and generous personal and sick days for our full-time employees. We also offer bereavement leave, including miscarriage and stillbirth support. Parental leave salary top-up of up to 80%, as well as a personalized return-to-work transition and accommodation plan for full-time employees. A generous product discount! Location Toronto, Ontario 60 Bloor Street W Hybrid; 3 days in office 2 days remote Salary: $72,000-$85,000 Looking for the perfect next opportunity is a big decision. title: Cardiology Nurse Practitioner - CST
full_text: About Us Heartbeat Health is the leading virtual-first cardiovascular care company in the country, providing patients with convenient, high-quality heart care through a combination of telemedicine, diagnostics, and virtual care programs. By leveraging real-time data and AI-powered insights, Heartbeat Health empowers providers and patients with personalized treatment plans, reducing hospitalizations and improving long-term heart health outcomes. Heartbeat Health is redefining how cardiovascular care is delivered in the digital age, led by our medical group of cardiologists, advanced practitioners, nurses, and care coordinators. About the Role We are currently seeking a Nurse Practitioner to join our virtual clinic supporting Central Time Zonefrom 9 am to 5 pm Monday through Friday. As a Nurse Practitioner at Heartbeat Health , you’ll play an integral role in delivering high-quality, patient-centered cardiovascular care through our virtual care model. This position is ideal for an experienced provider who is passionate about cardiology and comfortable independently managing complex cardiac patients in a remote environment. With a strong focus on Heart Failure management and Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy (GDMT), you’ll assess patients, develop and adjust treatment plans, monitor disease progression, and work closely with cardiologists, primary care providers, and other members of the care team. You’ll combine clinical expertise with education, advocacy, and evidence-based practice to help patients better manage their cardiovascular health and achieve improved long-term outcomes. Patient Assessment: Conduct thorough patient assessments via telehealth visits, including medical history reviews, physical examinations, and diagnostic tests, to evaluate cardiovascular health and identify cardiac conditions. Diagnosis and Treatment: Formulate differential diagnoses and develop comprehensive treatment plans for patients with various cardiac issues. Prescribe medications and order diagnostic tests. Disease & Heart Failure Management: Extensively manage chronic cardiovascular conditions remotely, with a heavy emphasis on advanced Heart Failure management, hypertension, arrhythmias, and coronary artery disease. Monitor patient progress, analyze real-time data, and adjust care pathways to optimize cardiac function and prevent hospital readmissions. Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy (GDMT): Expertly implement, titrate, and manage Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy (GDMT)for heart failure and alternative complex cardiac populations, ensuring clinical practice aligns strictly with the latest ACC/AHA guidelines. Education and Counseling: Educate patients and their families about cardiovascular diseases, prevention strategies, and lifestyle modifications. Provide specialized counseling on medication adherence, GDMT titration expectations, fluid/diet management, exercise, and smoking cessation. Collaboration: Collaborate closely with cardiologists, PCPs, and other healthcare professionals to ensure comprehensive and coordinated care for patients. Discuss complex cases and participate in multidisciplinary care teams. Research and Evidence-Based Practice: Stay current with the latest developments in cardiology research and incorporate evidence-based practices into patient care. Participate in research studies or quality improvement initiatives to enhance patient outcomes. Documentation: Maintain accurate and detailed patient records, including medical histories, assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, and discharge summaries. Ensure compliance with legal and ethical standards. Patient Advocacy: Serve as an advocate for patients' needs and preferences, ensuring that they receive appropriate care and support throughout their healthcare journey. Continuing Education: Pursue ongoing education and professional development in the field of cardiology to stay updated on the latest advancements and maintain relevant certifications. Quality Assurance: Participate in quality assurance programs to monitor and improve the quality of cardiology care provided within the healthcare facility. Availability: Must be able to work Monday through Friday, 9 am to 5 pm CST. About You Education: A Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) with a specialization in cardiology or a related advanced practice nursing field. Experience: 3+ years of dedicated experience working as a Nurse Practitioner in an outpatient cardiology setting or clinic environment. Licensure Requirement: Must hold an active, current, and unrestricted Nurse Practitioner (NP) license (preferably in a Compact State) Certification: Obtain and maintain Nurse Practitioner (NP) certification specific to cardiology from a recognized certifying body, such as the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC) or the American Academy of Nurse Practitioners Certification Board (AANPCB), in a relevant Nurse Practitioner specialty (e.g., Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner or Family Nurse Practitioner with a strong focus on cardiology). Clinical Expertise: Demonstrated proficiency in outpatient management, interpreting complex diagnostic tests (e.g., ECGs, echocardiograms), and optimizing clinical outcomes for advanced Heart Failure populations. GDMT Mastery: Proven expertise in the practical application, optimization, and protocol titration of Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy (GDMT). Emergency Preparedness: Certification in ACLS is required or highly recommended, as Cardiology Nurse Practitioners may be involved in emergency cardiac care protocols. Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills to effectively educate patients virtually and collaborate with a multidisciplinary healthcare team, including cardiologists and remote care coordinators. Critical Decision-Making: Ability to make critical decisions, analyze complex cardiac cases, and rapidly adapt treatment plans based on patient responses and changing clinical conditions. Empathy: Compassion and empathy when working with patients and their families, especially when delivering challenging diagnoses or managing chronic, life-altering cardiac conditions. Detail-Oriented: Meticulous attention to detail in patient assessments, virtual documentation, and treatment plans to ensure medical accuracy and patient safety. Technical Agility: Familiarity with electronic health records (EHR) systems, remote patient monitoring (RPM) tools, and other digital healthcare technologies used in virtual cardiology practice. About the role We're hiring an AI Engineer to design, build, and ship AI-powered features that go into production and stay there. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a research role. You'll work across the full path from problem framing to deployment: turning an ambiguous business need into a working system, choosing the right model and retrieval approach, building the evaluation harness that proves it works, and standing behind it once real users depend on it. You'll partner closely with product, design, data, and platform engineers, and depending on the engagement,  directly with client stakeholders who are new to AI and need a clear-eyed guide on what's realistic. What you'll do Build and deploy production AI features: LLM-backed workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic and tool-using systems, classification and extraction pipelines, and traditional ML models where they're the better fit. Own the data path behind those features: ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, and retrieval quality, and improve it based on measured outcomes rather than intuition. Design evaluation before you ship. Define what "good" means for each use case, build offline eval sets and online feedback loops, and track regressions as prompts, models, and data change. Integrate AI capabilities into existing applications and services through well-designed APIs, with attention to latency, cost per request, failure modes, and graceful degradation. Instrument and monitor deployed systems for quality drift, hallucination rates, token spend, and abuse, and act on what you see. Apply responsible-AI practices in day-to-day work: data privacy and residency, PII handling, prompt injection and data exfiltration risks, access control, and clear documentation of model limitations. Prototype quickly to reduce uncertainty, then make a deliberate call on what deserves to be hardened and what should be thrown away. Contribute to internal standards, reusable components, reference architectures, and patterns other teams can adopt. Explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical audiences, including client stakeholders and executives, without overselling what the technology can do. What you'll bring 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 1+ years building with LLMs or ML systems in production. Strong Python. Working proficiency in at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, Java, or Go for service and application integration. Demonstrated experience shipping an AI feature end to end, you can walk us through what you built, how you evaluated it, what broke, and what you changed. Practical command of the modern LLM toolkit: prompt design, structured output, function/tool calling, context management, and at least one orchestration framework or a well-reasoned argument for building without one. Experience with retrieval systems and vector search (e.g., pgvector, Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Elasticsearch, or similar), including how to diagnose bad retrieval. Cloud deployment experience on [Azure / AWS / GCP], plus containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code fundamentals. Solid data engineering instincts: SQL, working with messy real-world data, and building pipelines that don't silently fail. Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort operating with incomplete requirements. Nice to have Consulting, agency, or client-facing delivery experience. Fine-tuning, distillation, or parameter-efficient adaptation of open-weight models, and a sense for when it's worth it versus prompting or retrieval. Experience with agent frameworks, MCP, or multi-step tool-using systems in production. MLOps tooling (experiment tracking, model registries, feature stores) and observability platforms for LLM applications. Background in a regulated domain such as healthcare, financial services, insurance, or the public sector. Speech, vision, or document-understanding work (OCR, layout parsing, multimodal models). ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a hunter to drive new client acquisition for our Affiliate Marketing & Influencer Services. This is a new business development role built for someone who thrives on opening doors: sourcing opportunities, building relationships with enterprise decision-makers, and running a deal from first contact through close. Our marketing team generates inbound leads and our sales support team provides collateral and financial modeling, but the right candidate won't wait for leads to come to them.

This role is built around a team-based selling model. You bring the opportunity in the door, qualify it, and manage the relationship and the process; our strategy and account management teams build the narrative, the strategic recommendation, and lead the pitch delivery. Maintain complete, current vendor records in Zip, including executed contracts, W-9s, and other required documentation, updating them whenever vendor details change. Track upcoming contract renewals and proactively reach out to business units with enough lead time to kick off the renewal process before deadlines hit. Keep vendor contract, licensing, and compliance records current in partnership with IT, GRC and Legal. Train and support the broader org on procurement policies and how to use Zip, to drive adoption and policy adherence. Continuously optimize workflows in Zip so end users have a fast, clear experience submitting procurement requests, built for a fast-moving company. Minimum Qualifications 2 to 4 years of experience in corporate indirect procurement operations, purchasing, or finance operations. Hands-on experience with Zip or a similar procurement/spend management platform (Coupa, Airbase, Procurify); Zip experience strongly preferred. Working knowledge of NetSuite and how it connects with procurement and accounts payable. Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, or spend tracking. Comfort working through messy, unstructured data (contract cleanup, record audits). Ability to train and communicate policy clearly to non-procurement stakeholders. The ability to work independently, manage details, and build strong relationships across the company. Preferred Qualifications Experience working at a growing SaaS or technology company. Experience implementing or improving a procurement system or ERP integration. A background in Finance or Accounting, including experience with accounts payable and expense classification. Familiarity with SaaS procurement, software licensing, and vendor compliance. Indicators of Success This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months. A successful Procurement Specialist will: Make Zip the reliable source of truth for vendor contracts, with complete records and the renewal module fully operational. Build a proactive renewal cadence so business units are never caught off guard by an upcoming contract deadline. Become the go-to person for day-to-day purchasing questions and process execution. Put a clear, consistent purchasing process in place, including org-wide training, so employees and approvers know what to expect and policies are followed. Streamline Zip workflows so submitting a procurement request is fast and easy for end users. title: TestGorilla: Sr. People & Talent Operations Partner
full_text: Headquarters: Fully remote URL: https://www.testgorilla.com/ Senior People & Talent Operations Partner ⚡ This one's going to move fast. Where do we hire from? Almost everywhere. Check that your country appears on this page . For this role, you'll have at least 4 hours daily overlap with your UK-based manager. Hi there, I'm Olive Turon, Head of People & Culture at TestGorilla. I'm excited to share more about the Senior People & Talent Operations Partner role and our team. About TestGorilla At TestGorilla, we're on a mission to place 1 billion people in their dream jobs. To democratize opportunity, we're building the world's leading skills-based talent discovery platform - one that replaces reliance on resumes with scientific validation of what people can truly do. Founded as a 100% remote company in 2020, our global team is united by high standards, a lot of heart, and a relentless drive to conquer new technological frontiers. We're all AI-fluent builders who care deeply about replacing bias with fairness. After empowering thousands of companies to hire smarter and faster, we're now unlocking the next phase of our scale-up journey - where you'll play an instrumental role in creating a world where skills matter most! About the role As our Senior People & Talent Operations Partner, you'll own People Ops as a product: the systems, compliance, and self-serve workflows that let most of People & Culture run itself day to day, plus the tooling behind how we hire. You'll join a lean, two-person team, working directly with me, with proper and lasting ownership from day one. Payroll, compliance, and HR systems across every (35, currently!) country we operate in are foundational elements of this role. Just as critically, you'll build and own the AI/automation and self-serve layer that keeps our People function lean, bringing a product mindset to everything you touch.  Let’s face it: we’re a scale-up, so you’ll also need to be happy wearing other People hats when the moment requires. We're looking for someone autonomous, opinionated and candid, who'll tell me when I've got it wrong. You'll be dealing with real people and real problems, so you'll need to stay empathic but boundaried, structured and organized even when the pace picks up. I’m biased, but I think it’s a dream job: this is an HR role in an HRTech company changing the world of work for the better, we’ll have immense amounts of fun, there’s plenty of uncharted territory for you to make your own, and I’m committed to helping you to do the best work of your life. A quick check: if you've never built objectively clever automations (not just used one someone else built), this probably isn't the role for you. Automation is just that central to the job. Responsibilities In this role, your responsibilities will include: Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture. Designing, building and maintaining a smart, automated and AI-enabled people journey - from pre-boarding to off-boarding - that frees up capacity for bespoke, white-glove treatment where it matters Being the technical owner and orchestrator of our HR tech stack: evaluating and enhancing it, ensuring these tools are not siloed but unified and integrated. Owning the non-Finance side of payroll, invoicing, contract administration, and compliance end to end, across every country we operate in. Owning data privacy and recordkeeping, and the day-to-day relationship with our EOR vendor. Owning configuration and troubleshooting of our hiring tooling, so hiring managers can run their own searches independently. Owning the documentation that makes self-serve actually work in practice, ensuring that it’s structured in a way that is easily accessible to both humans and P&C AI agents. Working with me to maintain a clean line between what's self-serve and what needs a person. We do not aspire to automate our entire People journey here. What you'll bring We're looking for someone who: Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs. Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Has built and owned sophisticated automations (Zapier, n8n, Make.com, and the like) as a core part of an integrated HR tech stack, not just used AI tools day to day. Arguably the most important thing on this list. Has managed payroll, compliance, or HR operations across multiple countries, ideally through an Employer of Record or a mix of EOR and direct entities. Has deep, hands-on HRIS experience. HiBob experience is a big plus, and so is experience assessing or migrating HR systems. Brings a product mindset: builds for the people who use them (employees and managers), listens to their feedback, and iterates rather than building in isolation. Thrives in a high-autonomy, async-first, remote-only environment, and has worked in these kinds of teams and working cultures before. Marries operational rigor with genuine empathy and a real interest in people. You'll be dealing directly with team members, sometimes on sensitive matters. Is opinionated and candid, with excellent feedback and stakeholder management skills. Most people in this role will have acquired these skills over five years of relevant experience. That being said, we care far more about what you've owned, your impact and how you've progressed, than the exact number of years. We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone, even if your experience doesn't exactly match the description. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement - let's buck that trend! Bonus skills While these skills aren't a requirement, we'd be very interested to hear from you if you have any of the following: Experience with an ATS or hiring platform such as Ashby, Greenhouse, or Lever. Experience with an EOR provider such as Remote, Deel, or Oyster. HRIS implementation or migration project experience. Experience supporting a team through organizational change. What's in it for you? Please note: In this role, you'll be hired as an Individual Contractor. Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world. Competitive compensation: €56,520 - €70,650 base pay + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs). This role doesn't carry a bonus component. Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life. *Check out the countries we currently hire from here . Remote work budget: €1,000 available each year, or up to €2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop! Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities. Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches. Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being. Interested? At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true skills and experience match. When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment – it's your invitation to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data. Given the hiring sprint timeline above, we'd love to see your application land before September 20. Concerned about test anxiety or need help with the assessment? We've got you covered. Please check out our candidate support page for any questions. Accommodations are readily available as part of the assessment setup, and requesting support will never impact your application.
